newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's crude oil rose to 806,000 bpd in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's crude oil rose to 806,000 bpd in 1996.

text.p: Algeria's crude oil and natural gas rose respectively 5.9 percent and 6.8 percent to 806,000 barrel per day and 126 billion cubic metre in 1996 compared with the previous year, the official APS news agency said on Friday.
The oil output figure represented the first time Algeria has said it has risen above its OPEC quota of 750,000 bpd.

Quoting the official council Conseil National Economique et Social (CNES), the agency said: "The good performance of hydrocarbons and repercussions of the previous years' investments pushed up Algeria's production capacity in 1996."
The favourable environment on the international crude market was also behind the output increase, the council said.
